cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Delegate Downward
cards.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As junior coordinator, you'll deal with the blocked sink. I'll keep the event running.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ran yesterday's event. You promised me a promotion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Senior coordinator, then. Still reporting to me, but you can choose the plumber and supervise the repair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The only one available comes after everyone leaves. I'm not waiting here hungry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll order whatever dinner you want. You hold the building keys and lock up after him; senior site responsibility. Tell me the delivery time and I'll arrange the handover around you.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 lower rank justifies sink duty; A3 grants promotion while preserving reporting line and A5 dinner/timing concessions keep B accepting expanded site responsibility.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 earned promotion causes A3 senior title; B4 late hunger causes A5 dinner and keys for lockup.

relationship.evidence: B2 has a legitimate status claim and B4 a practical limit; A offers real support without taking the undesirable job back.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses the late visit to add locking up under the promoted-but-subordinate rank.

specificity.evidence: A1 blocked sink and B4 only available late plumber make the burden concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 senior site responsibility is character euphemism for the added lockup duty.
